material_findings.title: HackerOne now requires identity verification before bug-bounty submissions
material_findings.summary: HackerOne's current official ID Verification documentation states that all hackers must complete identity verification before submitting to bug bounty programs. VDP submissions are not affected. The verification flow generally requires an eligible physical identity document, can take up to 48 hours, lasts 12 months, and must be renewed annually. The official page exposes only a relative update age, so the exact effective date of this requirement is not asserted here.
material_findings.recommended_action: Before recommending a HackerOne BBP as immediately actionable, verify that the intended participant can satisfy the platform identity-verification gate and separately preserve the exact program scope/rules. Do not treat verification eligibility or a public listing as authorization to test any asset.
